title: Release, rollback and handoff

files.change: Operational runbook, rollback and bounded backfill commands; no secrets.
Release manifest, schema versions, image digests, tests, limitations and restore instructions.

steps: Feature branch from current authorized state; don't overwrite existing branch work. Additive migrations with restore rehearsal, then deploy canary flag and compatible readers.
Run ingestion and main backend focused suites; frontend npm test and production build via Docker. Build only changed services.
Deploy with docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml -f infra/docker-compose.vps.yml up -d --no-deps <changed services>; no down -v, prune or --remove-orphans.
Public health https://ajayan.tech/infodj/ plus authenticated workflow check; record previous image digests and keep additive schema on app rollback.
Confirm remote target and current user authorization before external push/main update/PR. No model may claim a PR or push without a verified URL/SHA.
tests: Rollback to compatible previous app image while retaining new evidence; no reverse destructive migration.
Restore backup in isolated environment; missing provider credentials reported accurately.
completion_evidence: release SHA and actual PR URL if authorized
all acceptance IDs proven or clearly unresolved; do not mark full goal complete otherwise
